scope: require a pre-existing C4 scenario_runtime binding before investigator creation can mutate state
validate scenario binding against frozen C4 route metadata and exact expected private source hashes
allow only C4 routes whose canonical path is ready and release class is PASS_REAL
delegate actor-bound investigator creation commit to validated Creation Batch3
delegate party finalization and PLAY_READY gate to validated Creation Batch4

private_validation_required: Actual new_canonical_session with exact private source files must be tested separately before any authority promotion.
